relevance_note: Single case report of a man with a LAMP2 frameshift and Danon disease: "We found a frameshifting mutation in LAPM2 gene which means that patient had Danon disease".
method_note: Built by hand from a reading of the full text (short case report, no tables); a small Python script only assembled the JSON. Gene symbol is printed as 'LAPM2' (apparent typo for LAMP2) and recorded as printed. No variant description is printed, so variant_original_string is 'not reported'; variant type 'frameshift' is from the authors' words. Zygosity and inheritance are not stated (no parental testing reported). The mother, who 'died suddenly at the age of 22 years', is included as a relative described in relation to the patient; she was not tested and no diagnosis is given for her; 'died suddenly' recorded as an observed feature, cause_of_death left 'not reported'. 'Heart failure symptoms progressively worsened from the age of 16 years' is worsening, not onset, so age at onset is 'not reported' and the phrase is kept as feature detail. Age at last evaluation is the age at presentation (23 years); age at diagnosis is not stated. 'non-obstructive' HCM recorded as LVOT obstruction excluded. Elevated AST/ALT are recorded as observed (the authors attribute them to myopathy). 'Other common laboratory tests were normal' names no specific test and excludes nothing. Hydrothorax and pericardial effusion come from the Figure 1 legend. Intermittent palpitations are not attributed to a specific arrhythmia, so the arrhythmia checklist items stay 'not reported'; complete LBBB is not AV block. No contradictions found.
